descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S23 「两个列表在手机宽度和 WebKit 上，默认状态」 Both lists at phone width and on WebKit, default state

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles

When Visual lane opens hospital-list and nh-list as opened (no search)

Then Search box, sort control and cards are fully visible and usable at phone width; nothing covered, no sideways scroll, tap targets large enough

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual lane covered / overflow / truncated / tap checks on hospital-list and nh-list in their default state; findings are evidence for a human. Not covered: the layout with a search typed and the open sort control. visual-lane.ts captures neither yet (same runner change as S22); S24 covers them by hand

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。
